- `TakeSnapshot()` returns `_changes.Count - 1` (the current position in the change log)
- `Restore(snapshot)` removes changes after the snapshot position
- `Commit()` processes ALL changes and then clears `_changes`, `_intraTxCache`, etc.

The actual invariant in this codebase is: "ALL change tracking (including new accounts) is cleared on every Commit, regardless of snapshot depth."
